title: Just 10 minutes of AI use may erode persistence on hard tasks
script:
Just ten minutes of AI use impairs your persistence on hard tasks.
Researchers from UC Berkeley, MIT, and Oxford discovered this trend.
Participants used AI to solve SAT reading and fraction problems.
Those using AI were less likely to persist on difficult prompts.
The study appeared at the Conference on Language Modeling.
Heavy AI users struggled more when they had to work alone.
This creates a dependency on instant, AI-generated results.
Does using AI make your brain lazier?
